commands.long_about:
Sign in with a browser session (last resort).

In browser DevTools, find the xoxc token under Application → Local Storage → https://app.slack.com → localConfig_v2 → teams.<team>.token, and the d cookie under Application → Cookies → https://app.slack.com. Treat both as passwords. Terminal input is hidden. Piped stdin: token on line 1, cookie on line 2.
